cues.text: The command room on the dorm's fourth floor. You sit on the sofas and chairs around a long low table with Mitsuru, Akihiko, Junpei, Yukari, Fuuka and Ken, Koromaru sitting among you and Aigis standing nearby. Akihiko and Mitsuru sit with their arms crossed.
You get up from your seat, and everyone turns to look at you.
